messages:
samir: Heads up — our nightly gpu-sweep cron (gpu-sweep job at 03:10 UTC) left ~12 orphaned inference pods on prod-gpu-cluster. Saw spikes in queued bench jobs and nightly-bench failed. Logs show PV attach timeouts. Anyone aware of recent PV changes?

infra-bot: Alert: cronjob/gpu-sweep failed 1961012345 — BackoffLimitExceeded. Check logs: /ops/logs/gpu-sweep/1961012345.log

maria: Can you paste the pod names? I'll check the node attachments.

samir: pods: inf-job-7xk2, bench-worker-9p2s (12 total). snippet from kube events:
```
kubectl describe pod inf-job-7xk2 -n inference
Warning  FailedAttachVolume  2m (x3 over 5m)  attachdetach-controller  AttachVolume.Attach failed for volume pvc-abc123 : multi-attach error
```
Seems PVs being considered 'in-use' across nodes.

eli: Multi-attach suggests the sweep deleted the pod but didn't release the attachment before detaching. Could be our sweep doing force-delete without waiting for detach. Which code runs the sweep?

samir: gpu-sweep v1.4.2 (cronjob -> job -> cleanup script in infra repo). I triggered a manual run earlier to clear stuck pods; maybe race.

jordan: Quick mitigation: we can drain affected nodes or force-unmount volume on nodes with `ssh node && sudo umount /var/lib/kubelet/pods/...` but prefer a safer plan. For now I've queued a rerun of nightly-bench to avoid blocking release. @maria can you take lead on PV cleanup?

maria: On it. I'll try `kubectl patch pv pvc-abc123 -p '{"spec":{"claimRef":null}}'` then delete the stuck pods. Will follow runbook: infra/runbooks/pv-stuck.md

infra-bot: Started manual job: infra/maintenance/force-pv-unbind #1961012345 by maria

samir: Thanks. After PV cleanup, can we add a lock in the sweep script: create a leader-election check and backoff when PV attach rate > X? Also schedule sweep at 05:00 UTC to avoid overlapping with model-sync (04:45).

eli: Agree. I'll open a PR with a small leader lock using the kubernetes leader election package + add metric emit. Will also add a canary flag `--dry-run` for first run.

maria: Cleanup done — nodes freed, pods re-created. Rerun results: nightly-bench now passed for run 1961012900. I'll file an incident note and link to PR when created. :thumbsup:

samir: Awesome. Please add to the cron runbook and ping @oncall if we change schedule. Closing thread after PR and incident note.
